subject.title: [Feature]: sessions_search — full-text search over the agent's own session transcripts

question: Should OpenClaw add a default core `sessions_search` tool and `sessions.search` gateway method for exact transcript lookup, or keep session-content recall under opt-in `memory_search` sessionMemory for now?
rationale: This chooses a new privacy-sensitive core tool, gateway API, and persisted transcript index boundary; automation can verify the gap but cannot choose that product/security contract.

options.title: Approve Indexed Core Search
options.body: Add the gateway-backed indexed tool with the same or stricter visibility and redaction guarantees as `sessions_history`.

options.title: Keep Recall In memory_search
options.body: Leave session-content search under the existing opt-in memory path and document the tradeoff instead of adding a default core tool.

options.title: Defer To UI/Mobile Session Work
options.body: Wait for related session-search surfaces to settle before freezing an agent-facing gateway contract.

recommendation.title: Approve Indexed Core Search
recommendation.body: Add the gateway-backed indexed tool with the same or stricter visibility and redaction guarantees as `sessions_history`.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete opened the protected product-direction issue and has the strongest observed history across session tool policy and adjacent session-management direction.
